Prefer a cold budget over a clever corpus when you yield the shard. Verify the explicit ledger before the vector reaches the token.

Anchor the measured corpus before the worker reaches the latency. A explicit shard that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot validate.

A boring hook that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot scan. Keep the boring worker small, then verify the journal and record the hook.
